changes: Restart installs the update even when it was pressed while the update was still downloading.
fastfetch and other system tools call the system Tacit instead of Arch Linux.
Signing in to Codex, ChatGPT or Claude from Praxis opens the browser.
In Thyris, a two-finger swipe to the right on the touchpad goes back, and to the left goes forward.
Sign-ins opened from other apps show inside the notch, no longer as a separate window next to an empty notch.
The wallpaper is sharp unless you blur it with the new switch in Settings > Wallpaper.
The see-through choice in Settings > Appearance changes the apps' windows.
Clicking a notification brings its app forward, or opens it.
On computers with NVIDIA graphics, Tacit turns on NVIDIA's own sleep and wake services.
Copy and paste works between Thyris and every other app, both ways, pictures included.
Pages in Thyris can take files again, and sign-ins open in the notch.
Pages in Thyris no longer stay stretched after a window opens beside them or Thyris is resized.
Night light, screen recording, a desktop monitor's brightness and USB drives in Files work on every computer.
The keyboard and touchpad no longer stop answering, and the brightness keys change the screen again.
The emoji picker shows its emoji, in colour.
Thyris blocks ads with uBlock Origin Lite on every computer.
Updates show how far they are, and what changed in them.
Setup puts Tacit in the computer's start-up menu when it installs next to Windows.
